The data analyst is responsible for overseeing our data systems and reporting frameworks, guaranteeing the integrity and precision of data. A large part of the role involves staying in regular contact with analysts, customers, partners, and tool users — explaining findings, supporting adoption, and helping teams make better use of data. Data analysts are also tasked with enhancing analytical and reporting functions, as well as supervising performance and quality assurance processes to identify areas for improvement.
cond_0033.responsibilities:
Driving roadmap initiatives around the Project Management functions in [Product name masked].
Conducting project assessments to determine compliance with internal project management and resource management standards.
Read, update, and develop data dashboards, charts, and data sets in [Product name masked] to support decision-making across departments.
Detect, examine, and decode trends or patterns within intricate datasets to scrutinize data and produce actionable insights.
Assist in the implementation and deployment of [Product name masked] enhancements and provide ongoing training and support.
Providing support and training to new and existing tool users, both individually and in groups, with regular one-on-one and group sessions.
Creating training materials and conducting user training.
Actively gathering customer input and observations to suggest solutions, recommendations, and enhancements.
Tracking progress and notifying management of issues that require escalation, and assuming responsibility for resolving or coordinating the resolution of resource capacity issues and project data quality concerns.
Meeting regularly with analysts, customers, and partners to walk them through the value of resource capacity planning processes and the [Product name masked] tool, and to drive adoption.
Locate and define new process improvement opportunities.
Evolve our data collection capabilities, analytics, and reporting process as the business evolves and grows by optimizing strategies, implementing databases, and managing security, data sources, and metadata.
Commissioning and decommissioning data sets as needed, while maintaining, cleaning, and organizing data sets as needed.
Keeping current with industry standards and implementing updates as needed or required.
Connect and communicate across multiple departments to coordinate effectively.
Adept at report writing and presenting findings clearly to different audiences.
Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
Read and update project and program level resource forecasts.
Identify recurring process issues and work with managers to find solutions and initiate improvements to mitigate future recurrence.

5+ Years in a Data Analyst and/or Data Scientist capacity.
5 Years of experience with [Product name masked] reporting, developing data dashboards, charts, and datasets in [Product name masked].
Strong knowledge of and experience with reporting packages (Business Objects, Tableau, Power BI, etc.), databases (SQL), programming (XML, JavaScript, etc.).
Knowledge of statistics and experience using statistical packages for analyzing datasets (Excel, SAS, R, SPSS, etc.).
High understanding of PPM disciplines; has worked in a team and covered strategic projects. Experience with dashboard customization, configuration, user interface personalization, and infrastructure management will be helpful.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail, accuracy, and actionable insights.
Excellent communicator, adjusting communication styles based on your audience.
Quick learner, adaptable, and comfortable in new environments.
Proactive, confident, and engaging; especially when it comes to large stakeholder groups.

Data analysts are tasked with enhancing analytical and reporting functions, as well as supervising performance and quality assurance processes to pinpoint areas for enhancement. Most people become stronger in this kind of analytical work over time as they build experience and learn from the data environments they work in.
cond_0419.responsibilities:
Driving roadmap initiatives around the Project Management functions in [Product name masked].
Conducting project assessments to determine compliance with internal project management and resource management standards.
Be able to read, update and develop data dashboards, charts, and data sets in [Product name masked] to support decision-making across departments.
Detect, examine, and decode trends or patterns within intricate datasets to scrutinize data and produce actionable insights.
Assist in the implementation and deployment of [Product name masked] enhancements and provide ongoing training and support.
Providing support and training to new and existing tool users, both individually and in groups.
Creating training materials and conducting user training.
Suggesting solutions, recommendations and enhancements based on customer input and observations.
Tracking progress and notifying management of issues that require escalation and assuming responsibility for resolving or coordinating the resolution of resource capacity issues and project data quality concerns.
Meeting with analysts, customers, and partners to showcase value and drive adoption of the resource capacity planning processes and the [Product name masked] tool.
Locate and define new process improvement opportunities.
Evolve our data collection capabilities, analytics and reporting process as the business evolves and grows by optimizing strategies, implementing databases, and managing security, data sources and metadata.
Commissioning and decommissioning data sets as needed, while maintaining, cleaning, and organizing data sets as needed.
Keeping current with industry standards, and implementing updates as needed or required.
Leadership skills and the ability to connect and communicate across multiple departments.
Adept at report writing and presenting findings.
Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
Be able to read and update project and program level resource forecasts.
Identify recurring process issues and work with managers to find solutions and initiate improvements to mitigate future recurrence.
cond_0419.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
5+ Years in a Data Analyst and/or Data Scientist capacity.
5 Years of experience with [Product name masked] reporting, developing data dashboards, charts and datasets in [Product name masked].
Strong knowledge of and experience with reporting packages (Business Objects, Tableau, Power BI, etc.), databases (SQL), programming (XML, JavaScript, etc.).
Knowledge of statistics and experience using statistical packages for analyzing datasets (Excel, SAS, R, SPSS, etc.)
Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail, accuracy, and actionable insights.
Excellent communicator, adjusting communication styles based on your audience.

High understanding of PPM disciplines, has worked in a team and covered strategic projects. Experience with Dashboard customization, configuration, user interface personalization and infrastructure management will be helpful.
Quick learner, adaptable and can adjust to new environments.
Proactive, confident, and engaging; especially when it comes to large stakeholder groups.
Capable of critically evaluating data to derive meaningful, actionable insights.
Demonstrate superior communication and presentation capabilities, adept at simplifying complex data insights for audiences without a technical background.

cond_0648.intro: We are looking for a certified data analyst to join our team. The successful candidate will work with others to turn data into information, information into insight, and insight into business decisions. The data analyst will help oversee our data systems and reporting frameworks, supporting the integrity and precision of data. This role involves working alongside the team to enhance analytical and reporting functions and contributing to quality assurance processes to identify areas for improvement.
